title: Conduit: AI agents for hospitality teams | Product Hunt
excerpt: Elevate the guest experience and automate internal operations across all your systems. Chat agents reply across email, WhatsApp, OTAs and social. Voice agents answer every call. Internal agents act inside your PMS and the tools your team already uses: dispatching work, updating calendars, closing the loop. 140+ languages, full observability on every agent step, SOC 2 Type II. 50M+ conversations and $3B+ in reservation value for 300+ brands including Marriott, Hilton, Nobu and Fairmont.
